name: test-support-shared-with-a-live-test
description: A declaration of test-support code that a test referencing a live target symbol also references counts as a live target symbol of every test that references it, so a test calling it and a production function only that test calls is no test of dead code. The production function is reported as test-only use, and what is reported about the shared test-support function is withheld at the default minimum confidence.
